name: Pirkanmaa Community Heart Association
mission: Community cardiovascular-health education and peer support.

facts.text: Pirkanmaa Community Heart Association is a registered association (registered_association) in Finland.
The association operates in the Pirkanmaa region of Finland.
The association's mission is community cardiovascular-health education and peer support.
The project Heart Health Saturdays delivers community workshops. This is a planned activity, not a completed result.
The requested budget is EUR 4,000.00 covering venue, materials, travel, insurance, and evaluation costs. All budget lines are proposed costs, not historical expenditure.
